newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Gemina to incorporate four units.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Gemina to incorporate four units.

text.p: Italian financial holding company Gemina said it plans to incorporate four subsidiaries in line with a continuing plan to streamline its structure.
The takeover plan will be put to an EGM in September.
Gemina said in a statement it aimed to incorporate Gemina Immobiliare, Gemina Leasing, Gefactor and Gesefi Finanziamenti, all entirely controlled by the holding.

After hiving off its industrial activities into Holding di Partecipazioni Industriali (HPI) earlier this year, Gemina has already incorporated two other units, Gemina Capital Capital Markets and Gemina Servizi Informatici.
